scientific_object.name: early embryonic ventricular-wall local patch
excluded_interpretations: late cushion or mature fibroblast model

base_scales.time: T0 = prescribed mechanical activation time scale

nondimensionalization.hard_rule: A_hat and H_ECM_hat are distinct frozen state variables; no density closure is implied.

reference_geometry_and_state.reference_frame: flat canonical patch with e_z from lumen toward outer myocardium

cell_targets.V0: exact signed volume of each finalized oriented reference surface mesh
cell_targets.A0: exact reference triangle-area sum for each persistent material face type
cell_targets.theta0: exact oriented reference dihedral angle at each persistent hinge
cell_targets.Lf0: distance between preregistered anchor-patch reference centroids

force_free_reference_conditions: passive constant surface tensions gamma_s are zero
all cell area, bending and volume targets are exact reference values
all registered interfaces have zero reference gap
normal cohesive traction is zero at zero gap
material tangential tether slip is zero
active preferred length equals Lf0 at alpha=0
support references equal reference nodal positions
reference_geometry_and_state.seal_before_solver: Hash vertices, oriented faces, material identities, anchors, ECM tetrahedra, boundary identities, material tether registry and support owners; any mismatch stops work.

coordinate_and_load_convention.current_endocardial_apical_outward_norma: n_a(x) from the consistently oriented current surface

topology_and_material_identity.cell_representation: one independent watertight consistently oriented closed triangulated surface per cell
topology_and_material_identity.ECM_representation: independent positive-orientation tetrahedral thin-volume mesh with two elements through thickness

active_preferred_length.anchor_identity: persistent material face-ID sets Gamma_minus and Gamma_plus
active_preferred_length.anchor_force_distribution: fixed normalized reference triangle-area barycentric weights within each anchor patch
active_preferred_length.net_internal_moment: zero because the pair is central

contact_and_adhesion.signed_gap: g>0 separation; g<0 penetration; pair normal points from side A to side B

steric_operator.purpose: prevent interpenetration for all eligible entity pairs
steric_operator.pair_set: dynamic deterministic geometric search recomputed at every accepted state

material_adhesion_operator.pair_set: constructed from reference geometry, frozen for the entire registered trajectory and SHA-256 sealed
material_adhesion_operator.reference_pairing: deterministic mutual-nearest quadrature pairing with lexicographic ID tie-break
material_adhesion_operator.reference_weight: fixed reference quadrature area owned exactly once
material_adhesion_operator.normal_potential: phi_adh_n=-w_adh*(1-3*s^2+2*s^3) for 0<=g<=g_c, s=g/g_c; phi_adh_n=0 for g>g_c; for g<0 use phi_adh_n=-w_adh
material_adhesion_operator.objective_tangent_basis: current orthonormal master basis obtained from the two oriented master-face edges with deterministic fallback
material_adhesion_operator.material_slip: delta_t=[r dot t1-r0 dot t10, r dot t2-r0 dot t20], where r is slave minus master material-point separation
material_adhesion_operator.tangential_potential: phi_adh_t=0.5*k_t*a(g)*||delta_t||^2, a(g)=1 for g<0, a(g)=1-3*s^2+2*s^3 for 0<=g<=g_c, otherwise 0
material_adhesion_operator.rigid_motion_requirement: delta_t and all pair forces are invariant under superposed rigid motion

contact_and_adhesion.complete_force_rule: Every pair force is the complete negative gradient of its discrete potential with respect to all participating current nodal coordinates, including gap, normal, closest/material points, interpolation weights, projectors and tangent-basis derivatives.
contact_and_adhesion.implementation_route: analytic differentiation or automatic differentiation; frozen finite-difference directional-derivative test is mandatory

full_patch_primary.lateral_support: outward lateral faces of perimeter myocardial cells only

gate_D.interpretation: test fixture only; excluded from the full patch

boundary_and_owner_contract.periodic_sensitivity: exact material-node pairing; lateral support disabled; outer support retained; zero-mean numerical gauge
owner_exclusivity: each material face has exactly one face identity
each external support face has at most one environment owner
an interface face cannot simultaneously own an environment port
each contact quadrature contribution has exactly one pair owner
internal transfer is never counted as external input

input_owners.P_fixture_D: moving Gate D fixture reference; zero in registered fixed-reference cases

failure_if: any registered dissipation falls below tolerance
any contribution has zero or multiple owners
normal orientation reversal changes the physical load

review_blocker_resolutions.B1: Exact reference-state targets, identity/anchor rules, Z0 and mandatory reference-bundle hashes are specified.
review_blocker_resolutions.B2: Dynamic steric search is separated from frozen material adhesion; complete discrete energy gradients and objectivity tests are mandatory.
review_blocker_resolutions.B3: Gate C support is assigned only to myocardial opposite_outer faces; the ECM lumen boundary is traction free.
review_blocker_resolutions.B4: A deterministic complete flat-patch geometry, normals, ports, support matrices and boundary ownership are specified.

completion_gate.next_required_action: independent read-only inspection of frozen Stage 0 v02; Stage 1 remains locked until separately approved
